Name: Veronnica's Portraits
Author: Veronnica0504
Description:
[color=#ea9999][size=5][b]MOD介绍：[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]这是我为1.6版本绘制的角色肖像美化包，目前包含12位可婚角色和7位村民（以适配我的[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22868]SVE肖像美化[/url]）。其余村民正在制作中，我会持续更新。
[b][color=#ff0000]请注意：[/color][/b]如果你下载最初的版本，请将 [u][CP]Veronnica's 12Marryable Characters Portraits[/u] 删除再安装新版本，否则会因为代码重复导致SMAPI报错。麻烦各位，谢谢。[/size]

[size=5][b][color=#ea9999]安装方法：[/color][/b]
[/size][size=3]1.需要前置MOD：[/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size][size=3]
2.解压后将 [u][CP]Veronnica's Portraits[/u] 文件夹放入 [u]Stardew Valley\Mods[/u] 即可。

[/size][b][b][size=3][color=#9fc5e8]--------------------------♥-----[/color][color=#9fc5e8]---------------------[/color][/size][/b][/b]

[color=#ea9999][size=5][b]About this MOD:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]This is a portrait pack of vanilla characters that I drew for version 1.6.
Currently contains 12 marriageable characters and 7 villagers (to suit my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22868]SVE portraits[/url]﻿). Other villagers are being made and I will continue to update them.
[b][color=#ff0000]Attention:[/color][/b]If you have downloaded the earliest version, please delete [u][CP]Veronnica's 12Marryable Characters Portraits[/u] and then install the new version, otherwise SMAPI errors will occur due to code duplication. Sorry for causing you any trouble, thank you.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][color=#ea9999][size=5][b]How to install:[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1. Requires: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size][size=3]
2. Put [u][u][u][CP]Veronnica's Portraits[/u][/u][/u] folder into [u]Stardew Valley\Mods[/u] .
[/size]
